name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 15, after point b – Am 80
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: (ba) Emphasises the importance of robust and proactive public policies on disaster prevention in all Member States, including the regular maintenance and reinforcement of critical infrastructure such as dams and waterways; stresses that the lessons learned from recent natural disasters highlight the need for continued investment in prevention and maintenance in order to reduce future risks;
